text:
kaya: heads up — were seeing ~4x p99 token latency on GPU-to-GPU inference when traffic crosses rack B3 -> B4. Local rack traffic is fine. :eyes:

matt: any packet drops or errors on ToR counters?

kaya: yes, counters jump when p99 spikes. grabbed a quick tcpdump and rdma stats. snippet:
```
17:02:11.123456 IP 10.4.3.12 > 10.4.4.9: Flags [P.], seq 1234:2345, ack 3456, win 65535
RDMA: retries=6, rnr_naks=2
etstat -s shows tcp retrans: 112 in 10m
```

olga: did we change MTU anywhere recently in AZ2? I recall an automation flip last night for jumbo frames.

jiwoo: checking config now — ToR B4 still set to MTU 1500 on mgmt interface, hosts on B4 are 9000. B3 ToRs and hosts are 9000. Thats a classic MTU hole.

andrew: Oof. So packets that are >1500 get fragmented/dropped between ToRs -> RDMA falls back to TCP, causing massive latency. Does RDMA try fallback to UDP? Behavior depends on nic offloads.

kaya: i ran `ip link` on a sample host on B4:
```
eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
```
but `ssh b4-tor01 'ip link'` shows `mtu 1500`.

deploy-bot: deploy event: topo-config-change/az2/2027-03-12T23:45Z by infra-automation (run id 81372) :gear:

matt: can we patch ToR B4 without a full rack drain? What's the risk to live traffic and Dedicated GPU workloads?

sre-oncall: risk is moderate — will flap if we push wrong MTU and path is active. Proposal: schedule fast maintenance window, update ToR control-plane MTU, then validate with rdma/ib tests and netperf. I can coordinate.

jiwoo: repro plan:
- fix ToR MTU to 9000 on B4 control plane
- run `netperf -H <other-host>` and `ib_read_bw` across racks
- observe RDMA verbs with `rdma link show` and `ibv_devinfo`
- watch LB handoffs for sticky sessions (internal-lb) to ensure no hairpin introduced

andrew: also check offloads: `ethtool -K eth0 tx off rx off gro off gso off` on a test host before change to see impact. If offloads cause segmentation differences we may need NIC firmware tweak.

olga: cost note — if we keep running fallback TCP RDMA for high-throughput model shards across racks, GPU unit-cost goes up ~30% due to slower token throughput. Worth prioritizing.

kaya: agreed. SRE, please book a 30m window 30m from now and ping infra-automation to roll back the config change if anything odd. I'll be on call to validate inference p99 and token throughput.

sre-oncall: booked 1795012600-1795012780 30m window. tagging @infra-automation and @networking.

matt: thanks — if anyone has a quick mitigation: we can pin heavy shard traffic to intra-rack scheduling to avoid cross-rack until fixed. Patch scheduler rule: prefer local placement for model-serving pods.

kiwi: (reaction) :thumbsup:
